collection.description: A village teacher has spent the morning explaining how to count the seasons by the stars.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a village teacher, has spent the morning explaining how to count the seasons by the stars. One child understands immediately, another keeps asking questions, and a third has quietly stopped trying. He remembers how hard learning once felt to him.

choices.label: Invite the Children to Teach One Another
Take the Class Outside to Observe the Sky
Ask What Makes the Lesson Difficult

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: He uses pebbles and drawings, and the struggling child finally sees the pattern.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: His new explanation confuses everyone, and he admits that he needs to try again tomorrow.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A shy student discovers that they can explain the idea beautifully.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The confident students talk too much, and he must make room for quieter voices.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The children notice details no one had mentioned in the lesson.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: A child admits they fear looking foolish, and he reassures them that questions belong in learning.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The children offer several different complaints, forcing him to reconsider his teaching.

c2__fx.name: Outcome C2
c2__fx.text: Clouds cover the stars; they learn how to work with imperfect observations.

c2__text.name: Outcome C2
c2__text.text: Clouds cover the stars; they learn how to work with imperfect observations.
